note: The narrative fact schema holds for discourse with a different act vocabulary and one extra field (topics). Same tiers, same lenses.

mapping.beat: a POINT/segment of the talk (sermon point, interview topic segment)
mapping.turning_points: replaced by KEY POINTS (P0) + the talk's thesis
mapping.fact.act_type: asserts | argues | illustrates (story/example) | cites (scripture/book/study) | asks | answers | advises | confesses | jokes | disagrees | agrees | prays | reads

facts.text: Meaningful engagement is the antidote to malevolence and suffering.
Meaning is found in responsibility, not in rights or impulsive pleasure.
Links maximal responsibility to the message of the crucifixion and to dragon-and-treasure myths.
1 Peter 3 asks wives to submit to their own husbands, not all women to all men.
A pastor teaching in Jordan found the pushback was against husbands honoring wives.
Husbands, work at fostering intimacy: dwell with your wives according to knowledge.
